gate.disclosure.title: Before we start
gate.disclosure.calavera: I am an artificial intelligence program from attorney Pankaj Raval's office. I am not the attorney and I am not a person. What I explain is general information, not legal advice.
gate.consent.title: May we keep what we talk about?
gate.consent.body: We keep a written record of what you type or say in the app, so the attorney can prepare your documents. If you say no, you can still keep learning.
gate.consent.label: Your answer, in your own words
gate.consent.again: Sorry, I didn't understand. May we keep what we talk about? You can answer “yes” or “no”.
gate.refused.title: That's fine. We keep nothing.
gate.refused.body: You can take every lesson. For the office to prepare your documents we need your permission; you can give it whenever you like.
gate.names.title: Who are the people in your family?
gate.names.body: Full names only: you, your spouse or partner, your children, and anyone you may name in your documents. Before asking for anything else, the office checks for conflicts of interest.
gate.names.label: Full name {n}
gate.wait.title: Thank you
gate.wait.body: The office is reviewing the names. We will let you know when you can continue with your details. Meanwhile, you can keep taking the lessons.
gate.disclosure.human: I help you learn and gather your information. Attorney Raval reviews and decides everything.
gate.error: That could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.

docs.title: Which documents are you interested in?
docs.body: You can choose more than one. Attorney Raval will tell you if another one would suit you better. You can change your choice until day 4.
resumen.title: Your summary
resumen.body: This is what you have told us, by document. You can correct any answer.
resumen.confirmed: Documents confirmed. Attorney Raval will review the scope.

acuerdo.title: Your agreement with the office
acuerdo.intro: Read it calmly. If you have a question, write it before signing: attorney Raval will answer it.
acuerdo.name: Type your full name

acuerdo.signed: You signed the agreement. Attorney Raval signs next; we will let you know when it is ready.
acuerdo.both: Signed by you and by attorney Raval.
acuerdo.wait: Your agreement will be ready when attorney Raval approves your documents. We will let you know.
acuerdo.changed: The agreement changed while you were reading it. Please review it again before signing.

cita.booked.note: We sent you the confirmation by email. You can change it up to 24 hours before.

pago.note: You pay on Stripe's secure page. The app never sees your card details.

firmados.title: Your signed documents
firmados.body: Keep the originals somewhere safe and tell the people you trust where they are. Here is a copy of each one.
firmados.funding.title: Move your property into the trust
firmados.funding.body: Your trust protects only what is in its name. Use this checklist; the office will guide you step by step.
firmados.none: Your documents will appear here after the signing.
firmados.final: Take the final lesson: take care of your documents
revisar.title: Review your documents
revisar.body: Attorney Raval has reviewed and approved these documents. La Calavera explains each part in plain words. If something is not right, ask for a change.
revisar.change.type: What do you want to change?
revisar.change.note: Tell us the change in your own words
revisar.change.send: Send the change to the attorney
revisar.decided.change: You asked for a change. Attorney Raval is reviewing it (about 2 business days).
revisar.all: Done! You can now book your signing appointment.
revisar.wait: Your documents will appear here when attorney Raval approves them.
